PlantQuarantine_New database, not a separate one.
PrepareSchemaIfNecessary is FALSE on purpose. The database is shared, live, and
already holds 298 tables plus 15,328 rows of production error logging. Letting
Hangfire silently DDL itself into it on deploy is not a decision a config default
should make. Create the schema deliberately instead - see the Hangfire section of
docs/MIGRATION-PLAN.md for the install script - then leave this false so the app
never needs DDL rights at runtime.
Set to true only for a local scratch database.
